challenge_summary: Pass-3 finding eaecc85f is CLOSED: Task 13 explicitly keeps application telemetry pending until the B06/B10 image and documents the UAMI-backed DefaultAzureCredential path without claiming deploy-time telemetry readiness. One new should-fix remains: all app traffic is routed through the hub, but the plan verifies only MCR egress and does not verify Azure Monitor egress.

findings.claim: Azure Monitor telemetry egress through the hub firewall is unverified
findings.evidence: Requirement 9 requires workspace-based Application Insights, and its Integrations row says public Azure Monitor ingestion is allowed through the hub firewall. The plan sets outboundVnetRouting.allTraffic=true and disables Application Insights local auth, but its live firewall evidence and Task 12 capability-18 preflight verify only app-to-mcr access to mcr.microsoft.com and *.data.mcr.microsoft.com. Task 13 leaves telemetry pending the B06/B10 image and does not verify an Azure Monitor egress allowance. The accepted B06 DefaultAzureCredential change addresses token acquisition, not network reachability; the entra-telemetry contract lists only App Insights local-auth and Monitoring Metrics Publisher dependencies.
findings.impact: If the shared firewall lacks an allow path for the App Insights/Log Analytics ingestion endpoints, the application will be unable to deliver required telemetry after B06/B10 despite valid UAMI authentication. Local auth is disabled, so there is no key-based fallback; required application monitoring can remain absent without a network-path check detecting the cause.

suggested_fix.proposed_edit: Add a read-only preflight check against afwp-hub for the effective Azure Monitor/Application Insights ingestion allow path from snet-app, or require explicit B08 confirmation of the matching rule/service tag. Keep telemetry pending until a bounded post-B06/B10 check confirms Entra-authenticated ingestion; do not enable local auth.
